description: comment-discipline — SessionStart injects the no-ephemeral-comments authoring directive on startup, resume, clear, fork, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction rather than being quietly dropped mid-session). SessionStart reaches the main session only, so subagents — which write plenty of code — get the rule from SubagentStart, which injects it into the subagent's own context as it spawns, before its first turn. PostToolUse on the edit tools is the backstop for spawns SubagentStart did not reach: it injects once per subagent on its first edit, and skips any agent SubagentStart already marked. Silent when the config sets enabled:false; with no config at all it emits a one-line nudge to run /comment-discipline init.
